title: qemu_x86 smoke build: Werror fatals in checkin.c and coap_keys_cbor.c
description: Discovered while verifying oa2i (local SDK 0.16.8, qemu_x86, 4.1.0 workspace): after the include fix landed, unrelated pre-existing hardening fatals block the build. (1) checkin.c:1773 lichen_rollcall_render stack usage 3424 bytes over -Wstack-usage=2048 - the documented vendored-Monocypher offender whose per-file -Wno-error exception lives in subsys/lichen/crypto/CMakeLists.txt does not cover this inclusion path; (2) coap_keys_cbor.c:156 -Werror=format-truncation (Z directive, uint32 secs into uint8 hh/mm buffers). Note: 4.1.0 workspace ignores the CSTD c2x property (v3.7-only) so these ran under -std=c99 - recheck under pinned v3.7.0 on the EC2 builder before fixing blindly.
